text:
Emma: opened PR to update Sapphire-3B and Aurora-lite model cards: limits, embed units, and a new small-batch vs large-batch bench section. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/871. Need bench sign-off and an SDKv3 snippet review.

Jordan: quick pass: embed table uses "embeddings/s" — we standardize on "embeddings/sec" across the site. Also the Sapphire card shows `max_input_tokens: 12288` but Hosted should be 4096; suggest a per-deployment row.

Li: runtime compat note: Sapphire int8 profile falls back to slower kernels on runtime < 2.4.5. Recommend this wording: "On runtime < 2.4.5, use the `sapphire-3b-no-int8` variant or upgrade the runtime; kernel fallback may increase latency."

docsbot: PR #871 created by emma — checks started (docs-lint, bench-ci, link-check).

Sam: I can take the SDK snippet. Will add Python (sync + stream) and TS async iterator examples. Plan to show streaming + function-calling fallback and a tiny snippet to auto-select `aurora-lite` when `latency_policy` triggers.

Kevin: bench update: I re-ran Sapphire-3B on g5.48x (seq=1024, batch=8) median=2,700 tokens/s; 95p=2,100. CSV uploaded: https://internal-storage/redwood/bench/sapphire3b/2026-03-25.csv. Old doc had 3,400 from p4d runs. I included both in a "Dedicated vs Hosted" subsection.

Jordan: good — can we add a short "bench environment" note with instance type, harness commit sha, and measurement config so results are reproducible?

Emma: added bench environment table and a "Deployment-specific limits" row for Hosted/Dedicated/Private. Fixed embeddings unit to "embeddings/sec". PTAL.

Sam: pushed SDK commit. Python snippet example:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
resp = client.generate(model="sapphire-3b", prompt="Summarize the release notes")
for chunk in resp.stream():
    print(chunk.text, end="")
```
Also added TypeScript example using async iterator and a short note on mapping `max_tokens`->`max_output_tokens` for migration.

Li: Left one inline nit about the compat sentence — suggest adding "kernel fallback" explicitly. I updated the sentence to: "Note: kernel fallback on runtime < 2.4.5 may increase latency; prefer `sapphire-3b-no-int8` or upgrade the runtime."

Kevin: bench-ci passed. Updated median/95p to match the g5 numbers and left p4d numbers in a dedicated block labeled "Dedicated (p4d)".

Emma: anyone object to merging before nightly deploy? Infra wants the compat table for routing rule updates.

Jordan: LGTM :thumbsup: small nit fixed.

Sam: LGTM, snippets tested locally. Added comment in the snippet about choosing `aurora-lite` when `latency_policy` > 200ms.

Li: LGTM. Merging now. I'll post a short note to #release-war-room and ping infra to pick up the compat table.

Emma: merged and posted release note. Thanks all!
